sentences.en: During the trip, John and I alternated driving the car.
sentences.zh: 在旅途中，约翰和我轮流开车。

sentences.en: Electricity from the power company is delivered as alternating current.
sentences.zh: 供电公司提供的电力是以交流电的形式输送的。

sentences.en: It has come to be viewed as an alternate spelling.
sentences.zh: 它逐渐被视为一种备选拼写方式。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：altern（改变状态）+ate（…的）→交替改变的→轮流的
